Nina Chen: Hey @People Ops — quick Q. Our UK contractor was planning to take PTO on Apr 10, but the UK bank holiday moved from Apr 7 -> Apr 10. They asked if we can convert their Apr 10 PTO into a floating holiday (so they don't lose a PTO day). What is the process and any payroll implications?
People Ops: Short answer: yes, we can swap to a floating holiday in most cases. Process below.
People Ops: 1) Employee submits a "Holiday swap" request in Workday (choose reason: 'Public holiday reschedule'). Attach proof (link to gov notice or company comms).
People Ops: 2) Manager approves in Workday.
People Ops: 3) Payroll codes the day as FH-INTL (floating holiday — non-taxable time off code) in the next payroll cycle or via manual adjustment if after close.
People Ops: Notes: - Requests submitted before payroll close for the period are processed automatically. If it's after payroll cutoff, we do a manual payroll correction (takes 1 pay cycle). - If employee is a contractor on a different payroll system, we may issue a one-off invoice credit instead; include contractor payroll type in the request. - Q4 year-end blackout: retro swaps are not allowed during the fiscal year-end freeze (we do allow prospective swaps).
Marta (Payroll): Confirming. If the swap request is in Workday and manager approves before the payroll cutoff (we're on the 15th/last schedule), we'll code FH-INTL and no manual steps needed. If it's after cutoff, please email payroll@redwood with the Workday request ID + approval screenshot and we'll queue a manual adj.
Kevin - Eng Manager: Approved from my side. @Nina can you ask them to submit the Workday request now so payroll has time? :thumbsup:
Nina Chen: Will do. I'll ping them and paste the gov notice link.
Nina Chen: (link pasted) https://gov.uk/sample-bank-holiday-change — submitted request id: WRK-87422
Payroll Bot: Ticket PR-8421 created for manual adj check (if needed).
Marta (Payroll): Got the request id. We'll watch payroll cutoff and confirm here by EOD tomorrow.
People Ops: Great — if anyone hits snags (contractor vs full-time mapping, different country calendars), dm us and we'll escalate.
Kevin - Eng Manager: Thanks all.
Nina Chen: Thanks!
